Expanded Blood Feats

Many question the existence of sanguimancy and haemothurgy as separate magical traditions. Blood is blood, is it not? An understandable question, if one that will get dismissive eye rolls from practitioners of both traditions. Why are sprinting and distance running separate sports? After all, running is running, is it not? As that example proves, often the difference comes down to specifics.

Sanguimancy is a broader tradition, available to more people. You can learn sanguimancy at any time during your studies, and you don’t even need to know other magic. It’s also a safer tradition, building a pool of power that you draw from. Once that pool is empty, your access to sanguimancy goes away until you rebuild it.

On the other hand, haemothurgy is a tradition of blood magic deeply tied with the process of magic. Those without the talent and inclination for magic find it much more difficult to pick up. It’s also far more reckless, pulling directly from the lifeblood of the user instead of building a buffer. It’s possible for a reckless or careless haemothurge to meet their end at the hands of their own magic.

Given how interrelated haemothurgy and sanguimancy are, it only makes sense that there is overlap between the two. Below are feats that deal with this overlap, as well as a new sanguimancer feat.

New Magic Item Types.text:
将既有指环作为力之指环

There are many ring items in the core game, like the Ring of Wizardry or the Ring of Swimming. You can choose to give these rings the abilities of power rings, like a specific magic weapon has the power of a striking rune. To do so, look at the level of the specific magic ring and round it down to the nearest power ring. For example, a Ring of Lies is a level 10 item, so it would have the properties of an iron power ring, while a Ring of Climbing, a level 12 item, would have the power of a silver power ring. If the item gives you an item bonus to a skill, remove that bonus. Be aware that this rule will increase the power of ring items significantly, should you choose to implement it.

无限之力

Power Rings are designed to be able to fit into any existing game without further changes being required; however, some GMs may feel they would prefer that the bonuses of a power ring always be active. If you are among these GMs, you can change the power rings so that their item bonus to spell attack rolls are always active; if you do so, simply apply the item bonus to any spell attack rolls of the wearer and add the following text to the end of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{料敌机先} spell: “The sure strike spell does not apply to spell attack rolls.”

力之指环

Power rings represent the methods by which spellcasters hone their attack spells into more formiddable threats, albeit, usually with their most consistent forms of magic: cantrips.

Scepters

Magic users and artificers are constantly working to advance the art and science of casting of spells and improve the magic items that might aid them. One way that has resurfaced in popularity is to use magic scepters that feed off the users current magic abilities to enhance and alter the magic they are casting. Scepters come in many materials and shapes, though most of them have a cylindrical base that is easy to hold on in one hand. They are often decorated and embellished in a way that belies their purpose. Using a scepter requires holding it in one hand. Scepters always grant access to spellshape and a once per day activated effect. activated effects will require sacrificing a spell slot of a rank indicated by the effect. If you are a prepared spellcaster, you choose one of your prepared spells to lose as if you had cast it. Spontaneous casters use one of their daily spell slots as if they had cast a spell from it. Most scepters will have a minimum and/or maximum spell slot rank required to activate it, listed in the effect.

Scepters have a limited capacity to convert spells into actuated effects, but similar to wands they can be overloaded to allow for additional uses. If you have already used the actuated effect of a scepter, you can attempt to Overload it. Roll a DC 10 flat check. On a success the activation happens as normal, but the scepter gains the broken condition and cannot be used for either the Spellshape or actuated effect. On a failure, the effect does not happen, you lose the actions, and the scepter gains the broken condition. In either case, the scepter cannot be repaired until the next time you make your daily preparations. Repairing a scepter requires using the Repair action or sacrificing a daily spell slot of the minimum rank required to activate the scepter.

Dynamic Spell Sage.name: 动态法术贤者 Dynamic Spell Sage
Dynamic Spell Sage.text:
替代规则：通用动态性

For some groups, the power and flexibility of spellcasters might feel a bit lacking. If that’s the case for your group, you might consider allowing spellcasters to cast the dynamic versions of all of the spells listed without the dynamic spellsage archetype. You can then apply all of the spell adjustments from the dynamic mastery section. Like the free archetype variant rule from the GM Core, this variant increases a character’s versatility without any associated cost (though this variant is less impactful than free archetype).

Applying universal dynamism requires adjusting the dynamic spellsage archetype. Replace the benefits of the Dynamic Spellsage Dedication with your choice of the Cantrip Expansion or Familiar class feats.

罕见

Dynamic spellsages are experts of magical manipulation. Instead of delving into the more typical path of the study of spellshapes, they focus primarily on bringing out the full potential of spells that can already be cast in multiple different ways. Through their spellcraft, magic can be compressed into a fraction of its normal power, or expanded to henceforth unknown levels. Most scholars of magical history believe that at least some of the flexible spells that are in frequent use today, such as heal or force barrage, were developed by the tinkering of dynamic spellsages in ages past.

Dynamic Mastery

As a dynamic spellsage, you’ve mastered a collection of variable action spells, allowing you to Cast them to greater effect. Whenever you can choose a dynamic mastery spell, select from the following list. These spells are sorted by source and type. Each mastery allows you to modify one of the options for casting the spell. The benefits do not apply to any of the other action costs.

Whenever you gain dynamic mastery in additional spells, you can also immediately retrain all of your existing dynamic mastery selections.

Core Variable Action Spells

These variable action spells appear in Pathfinder Player Core or Pathfinder Player Core 2. Apply the following enhancements to the spells that you select for your dynamic mastery.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZxHC7V7HtjUsB8zH]{灼热火矢}: When you cast the 3-action version of the spell, the spell’s range increases to 120 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TSyFZNAbqfkRrcq0]{协音合唱}: When you cast the 3-action version of the spell, creatures that fail the Fortitude save are deafened for 1 round, and those that critically fail are deafened for 10 minutes and off-guard for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{伤害术}: When you cast the 3-action version of the spell, you can choose any radius up to 40 feet.

Expanded Core Spells

These existing Pathfinder spells have new variable action versions in this book which are listed in the Dynamic Spell Variants section. These dynamic versions typically trade some of the range or duration of the pre-existing spell for the versatility of being able to cast 1- action, 2-action, and 3-action versions.

When you select one of these expanded core spells for dynamic mastery, however, you can regain the full strength of the default spell version while also retaining the dynamic spellcasting options. For all of these spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.HpZlCkpwAsStILMl]{动态神导术} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.u8BuGKcF9VYk9TZi]{动态盾牌术}, replace the 2-action version with the 2-action spell that shares its name without the word dynamic. For example, replace the 2-action version of dynamic fireball with the standard fireball spell. For dynamic guidance and dynamic shield, instead replace the 1-action version of the dynamic spell with its standard version.

New Variable Action Spells

These spells are entirely new to this book. If you select one of these spells for your dynamic mastery, apply the following adjustments.

Boom-A-Rang: When you cast the 2-action version of the spell, increase the slashing damage by 1d8.

Crushing Stampede: When you cast the 2-action version of the spell, you can select any radius between 20 feet and 40 feet.

Spirit Boundary: When you cast the 2-action version of the spell, you can select any radius between 5 feet and 30 feet.

Targeted Ward: When you cast the 2-action version of the spell, increase the range to 60 feet.

Celestial Aspects.name: 天界层面 Celestial Aspects
Celestial Aspects.text:
所有天界层面在其各自层面所列统计之外，皆共有以下统计。

特征 celestial, holy

感官 黑暗视觉

语言 Empyrean

技能 Religion

Weaknesses unholy

豁免调整Choose a save for each modifier: –3, +1, +1

Celestial Gift Choose either the gift of flight or the gift of vitality.

Gift of Flight The aspect gains the Flier aspect ability.

Gift of Vitality (healing, vitality) The aspect is an entirely good creature. The aspect can restore 1d6 Hit Points per rank of the spell to an adjacent creature as a single action. The creature is then temporarily immune to this effect for 1 hour.

速度25 feet

Melee 1 主要, Damage 1d6 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Holy The aspect deals 1 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die to creatures with the unholy trait and its Strikes have the holy trait.

Agathion Aspect

This animal-like celestial, like a vulpinal or a procyal.

Traits agathion

Languages speak with animals but only for animals related to its Aspect of the Beast.

技能Nature, 求生

Aspect of the Beast Select an animal type (such as feline for a silvanshee)

豁免调整 强韧 –2, 反射 +1, 意志 +0

Melee 1 次要 （娴熟）, 伤害 1d4 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Celestial Gift.

Gift of Flight The aspect gains either the Climber or Swimmer aspect ability depending on its choice of Aspect of the Beast (subject to GM discretion).

Gift of Vitality The aspect can deal vitality damage to an adjacent creature of the same amount it would normally restore with a basic Fortitude save.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains one of the activities listed for an 4th-rank animal aspect as appropriate for its Aspect of the Beast (subject to GM discretion) and increases the damage die of its 次要 attack by one step.

Angel Aspect

This celestial is of Nirvana, like a choral or a tabellia.

Traits angel

技能 Diplomacy, Medicine

Song of the Angels (auditory, aura 15 feet, emotion) The aspect grants all allies within 15 feet a +1 status bonus to saves against auditory and fear effects.

Ranged 1 次要 (range 60 feet), 伤害 1d6 + 环级 穿刺 or 1d4 + 环级 音波

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Celestial Gift.

Gift of Flight The aspect increases its Speed by 15 feet.

Gift of Vitality The aspect can cast heal as a spell equal to half the spell’s rank, but if it does the aspect spell ends.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect’s aura from Song of the Angels grants all allies a +1 status bonus to AC and saves and doubles the status bonus against auditory and fear effects.

Archon Aspect

This celestial is a Heavenly warrior of justice such as a zoaem or an aesra.

Traits archon

技能运动、Intimidation

抗力 fire

Archon's Protection R 触发 An enemy damages the aspect's ally and both are within 15 feet of the aspect; 效果 The ally gains resistance equal to twice the spell’s rank to the triggering damage.

近战 1 次要, 伤害 1d4 + 环级 火焰

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Celestial Gift.

Gift of Flight The aspect can Fly up to half its fly Speed towards the triggering ally when it uses Archon’s Protection.

Gift of Vitality The aspect can make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy when it uses Archon’s Protection if the enemy is within range.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Behold! Activity.

Behold! 2 (concentrate, emotion, fear, illusion, visual) The aspect reveals its true nature to all enemies within 30 feet. Creatures in the area must make a 意志 save or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). Frightened creatures lose their resistance or immunity to fire damage from the aspect’s effects. Creatures are then temporarily immune to this effect for 1 minute.

Azata Aspect

This mercurial celestial hails from Elysium, like a lyrakien or a kanya.

Traits azata

技能Diplomacy, Performance

Resistances acid, cold, electricity, or fire; Weaknesses cold iron

Freedom of the Azata (auditory, aura 15 feet, emotion) The aspect grants all allies within 15 feet a +1 status bonus to Escape checks and to saves against effects that would give it the grabbed, immobilized, or restrained conditions. The aspect treats difficult terrain as normal terrain.

Ranged 1 次要 (range 60 feet), Damage 1d4 + 环级 穿刺

Heightened (4th) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Celestial Gift.

Gift of Flight The aspect increases its Speed by 15 feet.

Gift of Vitality The aspect sings and inspires all within range. All allies within 30 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Liberate action.

Liberate 1 (concentrate) The aspect loosen the bonds holding a creature back. A creature of its choice within 30 feet can a ttempt to Escape as a free action. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Monitor Aspects.name: 监督层面 Monitor Aspects
Monitor Aspects.text:
所有监督层面在其各自层面所列统计之外，皆共有以下统计。

Traits monitor

感官 黑暗视觉

语言 two languages from the outer planes and one common language

技能 Religion, one skill of your choice

Monitor’s Directive Choose either the directive of guidance or the directive of punishment.

Directive of Guidance The aspect can teach others its ways well. It gains the Enhanced Aid (Religion) aspect ability.

Directive of Punishment The aspect seeks to destroy those that defy it. It deals 1 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die to creatures listed in the aspect’s Punished Creatures.

豁免调整 Choose a save for each modifier: –3,+1,+1

速度 25 feet

近战 1 主要, 伤害 1d8 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Aeon Aspect

This monitor is from Axis, like an axiomite or a pleroma.

Senses envisioning (aura, divine, mental) 100 feet.

Languages envisioning

Punished Creatures demons, proteans, azata, and creatures that promote chaos (subject to GM discretion)

Perfect Averages 1 (fortune) The aspect makes a Strike. It does not roll damage and instead automatically deals the average damage. For example, rather than rolling 2d8 for damage, it takes a value of 9 instead of the roll and adds any flat damage as normal.

高阶 (4 阶) The aeon gains an additional benefit from its Monitor’s Directive.

Directive of Guidance Once per round, the aspect can use Aid as a free action instead of a reaction.

Directive of Punishment When the aspect uses Perfect Averages, its Strike gains the fatal trait.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Fundamental Sphere action.

Fundamental Sphere 2 (concentrate, manipulate) The aspect creates a sphere with varying effects depending on its choice for Monitor’s Directive. The sphere appears within 30 feet of the aeon in a 5-foot burst and lasts for 1 minute. The aspect can spend a single action with the concentrate trait to move the sphere to another location within 30 feet of it. Creatures in the area at the beginning of their turn take the listed effect for the aeon’s directive.

Directive of Guidance (healing, vitality) The sphere is a Sphere of Creation. Creatures in the area regain 1d6 Hit Points per rank of the spell. Regardless of the result, creatures are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Directive of Punishment (death) The sphere is a Sphere of Destruction. Objects in the area take 1d10 damage per rank of the spell. Creatures in the area take 1d6 physical or spirit damage, whichever would be more harmful, with a basic Fortitude save. Regardless of the result, creatures are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Aesir Aspect

This monitor is a spirit of warfare preparing for the final battle of the universe, like an einherji or a valkyrie.

语言 Jotun

Punished Creatures giants, creatures that swear themselves to battle as a cause (subject to GM discretion)

Shield Maiden The aspect wields a shield or uses a weapon to parry like a shield. It can raise a shield as an action, granting itself +2AC. The shield’s hardness is equal to twice the spell’s rank, HP equal to quadruple the spell’s rank, and a BT equal to double the spell’s rank. It also gains the Shield Block reaction.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Monitor’s Directive.

Directive of Guidance (auditory, aura 15 feet, emotion, mental) The aesir teaches those around it to battle at their best. It has a warrior’s aura in a 15-foot emanation which grants allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while in the area.

Directive of Punishment The aesir gains the Flier aspect ability.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Spears of the War ability.

Spears of War 2 (magical) 频率 once per minute; 效果 The aspect can unleash a storm of spears, dealing 1d8 force, piercing, or electricity damage per spell rank to all creatures within a 30-foot cone with basic Reflex save.

Protean Aspect

This monitor is of the Maelstrom, like an azuretzi or a keketar.

语言 Protean

Protean Anatomy Immediately after the aspect takes energy damage, the aspect gains resistance to that damage type. This lasts until the next time the aspect takes damage of one of the other types, triggering a new resistance.

Punished Creatures aeons, devils, demons, qlippoth, tyrants, and creatures of absolute order (subject to GM discretion).

Flier The aspect gains the Flier aspect ability.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Monitor’s Directive.

Directive of Guidance The aspect’s senses heighten. It gains an entropy sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

Directive of Punishment The aspect deals 1 additional force damage per weapon damage die to objects, structures, and creatures with the construct trait.

高阶 (8 阶) When the aspect critically Strikes a creature, it triggers a warpwave, and the target must make a Fortitude save, suffering the listed effect on a failed save. Roll 1d8 and consult the table below for the specific effect on that creature. Unless indicated otherwise, a warpwave effect lasts for 1d4 rounds, and a new warpwave effect negates any previous warpwave effect already affecting a creature.

Psychopomp Aspect

This monitor is a guardian of the dead from the Boneyard, like a nosoi or a vanth.

语言 Requian

Punished Creatures daemons, necromancers, undead, other creatures which eat souls (subject to GM discretion)

Psychopomp’s Dirge 2 (auditory, concentrate, divine, incapacitation, mental) The aspect exudes a melody which garners the attention of the dead. Each undead creature within a 30-foot emanation must attempt a 意志 save or be fascinated with the aspect. The effect lasts until the end of the aspect's next turn, but it can Sustain the effect by continuing the music. Despite being a mental effect, this ability affects mindless undead. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune for 1 day.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Monitor’s Directive.

Directive of Guidance The aspect’s Strikes gain the ghost touch property and it increases the area of its Psychopomp’s Dirge to 60 feet.

Directive of Punishment The aspect gains the Flier aspect ability.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Capture Soul ability.

Capture Soul 2 (divine) The aspect attempts to capture the soul of a living creature or an undead creature. The target must attempt a 意志 save but creatures with more than 40 Hit Points treat their result on this save as one better than normal. If the aspect targets a living creature, this activity gains the death trait. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.
成功 The creature is unaffected.
失败 If the creature is living, it becomes drained 1 (or increases its drained condition by 1). If the creature is a corporeal undead, it becomes enfeebled 2 for 1 minute. If the creature is an incorporeal undead, it becomes stupefied 2 for 1 minute.
大失败 The aspect captures the creature's soul. If the creature is living, it dies and if it is undead it is destroyed with its soul returning to the aspect. The aspect spell then ends, as the aspect returns the soul to the Boneyard.

Where Essences Mix.name: 精质交融之处 Where Essences Mix
Where Essences Mix.text:
血怒者汲取魔法

精质施法者无需补充已失法术位之效果。取而代之，0 精质的血怒者若对敌人使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.XKAlLI17siAXFFyD]{汲取魔法} 专长，便可在战斗中以汲取戏法再度获得精质——纵使他们不具备「精质重生」职业特性。他们可在同一战斗中多次如此运用。

Drain Bonded Item

The wizard’s @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.au0lwQ1nAcNQwcGh]{奥术连结} feature grants you a prepared spell or spells instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{汲取附装物品}; you gain an additional spell prepared of any rank the bonded item could have provided a spell slot (one of up to your highest rank for most wizards, or one of each rank for wizards of the school of unified magic theory).

Freeze Time

Some spells like freeze time allow you to take several turns in a row. In these situations, you normally can’t gain or use essence, so you need to cast cantrips and focus spells. This makes those spells less useful unless you have focus spells or items you’d like to use during the frozen time. You can instead use this essence casting version of freeze time, replacing the normal effects of the spell.

You temporarily stop time for everything but yourself, allowing you to use several actions in what appears to others to be no time at all. Immediately after casting freeze time, you can use up to 9 actions in 3 sets of up to 3 actions each. While time is frozen, your essence draw and essence pool are 1 lower than normal, and you can’t use essence rebirth; if you would complete an essence cycle, you experience an essence leak instead, and at the end of the frozen time, you immediately experience an essence leak and return to 0 essence. After each set of actions, 1 round passes, but for only you, effects specifically targeting or affecting you, and effects that you create during the stoppage. All other creatures and objects are invulnerable to your attacks, and you can't target or affect them with anything. Once you have finished your actions, time begins to flow again for the rest of the world. If you created an effect with a duration that extends beyond freeze time's duration, such as wall of fire, it immediately affects others again, but it doesn't have any of the effects that happen only when you first Cast the Spell.

The above description is automatically applied to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.1dsahW4g1ggXtypx]{时间冻结} when added to an essence spellcaster.

Essence Staves

Staves empowered by essence prepared casters function as if they were staves for spontaneous casters (1 charge gains you access to the spells on the staves list as if you had them prepared).

Quickened Spell

You can instead use this essence casting version of the class feat Quickened Spell, replacing the normal effects of the feat (retaining all other aspects of the feat such as frequency):

“If your next action is to cast an essence spell of a rank less than or equal to your essence draw, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action). It doesn't cause an essence leak or increase your current essence, and you can cast another essence spell this turn.”

The above description is automatically applied to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.z2ptq23nNBOeEI7H]{快速施法} when added to an essence spellcaster.

Staff Nexus

You can choose to gain 2 fewer spells prepared, both of which must be of the same rank, to grant a number of charges to your staff equal to the rank of the chosen spells during your daily preparations instead of the ability to expend a spell slot to gain charges.

Two Round Castings

If you Cast a Spell that would increase your essence and take 2 rounds to cast, such as horizon thunder sphere, you increase your essence by 1 each round you Cast the Spell.

Wellspring Mage

先决条件 You are a spellcaster that gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.nWrMVX6rsQanqjlj]{不稳抽取} as a class feature

Essence caster wellspring mages work slightly differently than their slot-based counterparts. Replace the flat check in the wellspring mage adjustments with a DC 15 flat check: on a success, you draw 1 essence automatically at the start of the encounter without needing a draw cantrip, and on a critical failure you generate a wellspring surge. You can gain the success effect at most twice per day. Wellspring Mage Dedication removes this limit on the success effect. When you reach 5th level, you lose this benefit and instead gain the following: At the beginning of an encounter, you must use unstable draw, and the flat check DC for this mandatory unstable draw is reduced to 5. On a failure or critical failure, you produce a wellspring surge at a rank randomly determined from your essence spell ranks.

Ooze Aspect.name: 黏液层面 Ooze Aspect
Ooze Aspect.text:
黏液层面是黏液与软泥的凝结，犹如下水道软泥、丝状黏液或食肉粘块。

特征 黏液、无心智

感官 动感感应 30 尺；无视觉

语言 无（不能说话）

Essence Casting Class Features

The rules for bounded essence spellcasting can be found on page 69, as your spellcasting works differently. Essence spellcasting alters the normal spellcasting feature typically granted by a given class (for instance, “wizard spellcasting”), terminus of ultima replaces the class feature normally gained at 19th level that grants a 10th-rank spell (for instance “archwizard’s spellcraft), and all the other features are in addition to the normal features granted by the character’s class.

Gaining Essence in Encounters

When you’re in a combat encounter (or rarely in another dire and stressful situation, as determined by your GM), the magical essence you channel for your spell’s tradition gathers in your body, mind, lifeforce, and spirit. As you chain your magic, your essence grows, until you reach your apex. If you have the essence rebirth class feature, you can then begin again.

When you start an encounter, you normally have 0 essence, but you can use a draw cantrip to increase your essence up to your essence draw value. If you have more than 0 essence, once per turn you may cast an essence spell with a rank up to the amount of essence you have. After casting an essence spell in this way, if you used at least 2 actions for your Cast a Spell activity, you increase your essence by 1, otherwise you cause an essence leak. If an effect would normally expend a spell slot without you having to Cast the Spell, such as the Channeling Block cleric feat, you expend your essence instead and cause an essence leak.

If gaining essence would put you above your essence pool (normally equal to the highest rank spell prepared or in your repertoire, not counting 10th-rank spells, see below), if you’re a normal spellcaster, you complete an essence cycle and your essence returns to 0. Unless you have the essence rebirth class feature, you can’t gain essence again until the next time you’re in a different encounter, or dire and stressful situation.

Essence Leaks

When you cause an essence leak, you reduce your current essence to 0 immediately after you Cast the Spell that caused the essence leak and you fail to complete an essence cycle and you cannot draw essence again unless you have the essence rebirth class feature.

Durations and Temporary Immunity

All essence spells end as soon as the encounter ends. Since you can’t gather essence round by round outside of an encounter, you can instead cast any spell you’ve prepared or in your repertoire with an incantation or a long incantation.

All of your essence spells that counteract effects, reduce or remove conditions or afflictions, and so on grant temporary immunity to their target for 1 day after you cast them. This temporary immunity only applies to the same spell cast by you.

Classes With Unusual Numbers of Slots

Some classes have more or fewer slots than the baseline amount that classes like bards, clerics, or druids have, where they gain up to 3 slots per rank, and these classes are treated differently in essence casting as well.

Classes that grant up to 4 slots per rank like sorcerer and wizard (but not classes like animist that have a unique structure that adds up to 4 slots) gain an added benefit starting at 3rd level: for every rank aside from their maximum rank, they get 5 spell slots or spells in their repertoire instead of 4. So at 3rd level, they would have 5 1st-rank spells and 3 2nd-rank spells. Universalist wizards gain the same benefit because of the way their bonded item grants them additional spell slots, bringing them up to 4 slots in practice (see page 71 for more information on bonded items).

Psychics, which grant up to 2 slots per rank, instead gain a restriction: They can’t use the unstable draw feature normally gained at 5th level, and the first time they cast an essence spell during an encounter, they automatically experience an essence leak. They can’t use any other effect that would grant them a greater benefit in exchange for a leak on this guaranteed leak.

Animists work a little differently than other spellcasters and so they have their own rules. An animist only gains as many apparition spells of each rank as they have slots for apparition spells of that rank, which is typically 1 for their top 2 ranks and 2 for the rest. They choose from among the spells granted by all their apparitions. Only 1 apparition spell at each rank is a signature spell, and they can choose which of the ones they picked to be the signature spell at each rank. As stated above, animists don't gain a 5th spell slot at their lower ranks like sorcerers or wizards do. Instead, they effectively gain the benefits of prepared casting for half their spell slots while still having as many signature spells as a spontaneous spellcaster.

Thurse Aspects.name: 霜巨层面 Thurse Aspects
Thurse Aspects.text:
所有霜巨层面在其各自层面所列统计之外，皆共有以下统计。

特征 varies (see Creature of Folklore)

感官 微光视觉, varies (see Creature of Folklore)

语言 varies (see Creature of Folklore)

技能 Athletics

Creature of Folklore A thurse is a folkword used to describe a mighty, powerful being, whether it has the shape of a humanoid or a beast. Choose either Beast or Giant.
Beast The Aspect is a creature of the wild, an animal with magical powers or intelligence far exceeding regular fauna. It gains the beast trait, has scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, and increases one of its Speeds by 10 feet. The thurse speaks fey.
Giant The aspect is a giant, the mortal children of titans that live in the far reaches of our world. It gains the giant trait and the maximum size of the aspect is one step larger than normal. The thurse speaks jotun.

豁免调整Choose a save for each modifier: –2,+0,+1 or –3,+1,+1 or –3,+0,+2

速度25 feet

领域 The aspect rules over a particular domain. Select one of the following.
Caves The thurse lurks in caves, mountains or underground. It gains 黑暗视觉.
Forests The aspect lives in the woods. It gains the Climber aspect ability.
Plains The thurse lives in open plains, or on the edges of society. Increase the number of Hit Points per rank of the spell for the aspect by 1.
Skies The aspect flies through the air. The thurse gains the Flier aspect ability.
Waters The aspect lives in or by water. The aspect gains the Swimmer aspect ability and gains the aquatic trait.

Empowered Aspect

This thurse has the boons of an element, like a frost giant, a troll or a phoenix.

技能 Lore in the element from its Elemental Gift

Melee 1 主要, 伤害 1d8 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍 or 近战 1 主要 （娴熟）, 伤害 1d6 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Elemental Gift Choose the air, cold, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood trait. The aspect gains that elemental trait. The aspect Strikes deal 1 additional damage per weapon damage dice. The damage type is the same as the selected elemental trait, or the same as the Strike if the trait does not have a specific damage type.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect’s body flows with the power of their element, regrowing limbs or heads or covering up dire wounds. It gains fast healing equal to the rank of the spell.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Caster ability. The aspect’s spells are the same as an 8th-rank elemental aspect with the same elemental trait as the empowered aspect.

Monstrous Aspect

The aspect is more fungal than plant-like. The may be a myceloid or drakuthix.

技能 Intimidation

Melee 1 主要 (razing), 伤害 1d8 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍 or 近战 1 主要 (agile, razing), 伤害 1d6 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Fabled Tales The aspect is well known in myths and legend, causing creatures to be particularly apprehensive towards fighting them. The aspect has the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect is quick to lunge on its prey. It gains the Fear the Fabled action.

Fear the Fabled 1 需求 There is a frightened creature within reach of the aspect; 效果 The aspect Strikes the target creature. If the Strike is successful, the target does not reduce their frightened condition at the end of their next turn unless they can no longer see the aspect.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains a ranged attack, either by hurling a portion of its anatomy or a large object nearby.

Devastating Hurl 1 频率 once per round; 效果 The aspect hurls an attack at an enemy. The aspect makes a Strike with its 主要 attack against a creature within 60 feet as a ranged attack.

Noble Aspect

This thurse is one often ascribed heroic or regal traits, like a kirin, a cloud giant, or a grisantian lion.

技能one skill of your choice

抗力 piercing; 弱点 axe

近战 1 主要, 伤害 1d8 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Thurse of Bravery (aura 15 feet, emotion, mental) Even mere proximity to the thurse is enough to give someone courage. All creatures within the aspect’s aura immediately reduce any frightened conditions they gain by 1.

高阶 (4 阶) Victory is all but assured in the presence of the thurse. When the aspect critically succeeds on a roll, it gains a boost of strength, giving it temporary Hit Points equal to twice the rank of the spell that last for 1 minute.

高阶 (8 阶) The cry of the aspect spurs allies to victory and causes enemies to cower. It gains the Legendary Cry action.

Legendary Cry 2 (auditory, emotion, mental) 频率 once per minute; 效果 The aspect roars out, affecting the hearts of all allies within a 30-foot emanation, granting them temporary Hit Points equal to twice the rank of the spell for 1 minute. Allies also gain a +1 status bonus to melee attack rolls for as long as they have temporary Hit Points.

Riddlemaster Aspect

This thurse is an elusive creature that often speaks in riddles. Riddlemasters often are sphinxes, naga or cyclopses.

Languages one common language of your choice

技能 Diplomacy and one skill of your choice, Riddle Lore

近战 1 主要, 伤害 1d8 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Enhanced Aid (Riddle Lore)

Quick Witted The aspect has the Bon Mot skill feat.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains the Pose a Riddle activity.

Pose a Riddle 2 (linguistic, mental) 频率 once per minute; 效果 The aspect recites a riddle and compels a creature within 30 feet to make a 意志 save or answer. Creatures that fail their save are stupefied 2 (or stupefied 3 on a critical failure) until they successfully Recall Knowledge using any skill against the same DC as this effect or 1 minute has passed, whichever comes first.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Caster ability. Familiar Forbisens.name: 魔宠禁忆 Familiar Forbisens
Familiar Forbisens.text:
当法师与其魔宠相伴足够长时间后，他们或许发现彼此之间的羁绊朝某一特定方向倾斜。为了将其专精化，施法者会执行一项神秘仪式，唤醒魔宠之中的特殊力量，赐予其一项「禁忆」——独特于某个魔宠技能组合的特殊能力。

「唤醒禁忆」仪式施加于一名魔宠之上，并移除你通常在每日准备中可自由选择的两项魔宠能力。作为交换，它赐予一组永久而强大的能力，称为「禁忆」。仅当你拥有足够多的自由选取魔宠能力（除了你特定魔宠所需的能力之外）时，你才可对一名特定魔宠施行此仪式。若你的特定魔宠已经拥有该「禁忆」所赐予的一项或多项魔宠能力，你选取该「禁忆」所需的魔宠能力数量便会减 1。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.fXtie172vmvZhDSF]
1 级仪式

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.fXtie172vmvZhDSF inline]

禁忆 Forbisens

下列每项「禁忆」皆列出其授予的魔宠能力及所需魔宠能力之数量。若你至少 7 级，每日准备时你可从所选「禁忆」对应的进阶能力中选择一项作为新的魔宠能力。

若选取某项魔宠能力时需在挑选「禁忆」之际作出抉择（例如「戏法羁绊」或开放式技能选取），你须在选择该能力时一并决定其全部细项。例如：「戏法羁绊」要求你在执行「永恒禁忆」仪式之时指定戏法，且在你失去该魔宠之前无法更改这一选择。

Archmage.name: 大法师 Archmage
Archmage.text:
罕见

大法师是大多数法师初窥魔法奥秘时所力求达到的巅峰。可惜对多数人而言，真正的大法师必须驾驭远超绝大多数施法者所能企及的能量。幸运的是，那种能量对你而言已是触手可及。

你以审慎而有度的方式混合传奇之力与诡奇能量，借此释放与「狂野法术」（一种被视为传奇魔法化身的力量）相近的强大魔法；但与那不受约束的魔法能量奔流不同，你在自身魔法周围构筑了壁垒与界限，防止其压垮你凡躯的极限。你不像狂野法术者那样拥有燃烧的双眸与盘旋的魔法光环，因此不易被一眼看穿，但任何与你共处较久的施法者或许都能察觉你内里那受紧束之力的端倪。魔法如沉重的裹布般环绕着你，肉眼不可见，却几乎令人窒息于其浩瀚之重压。

在戈拉里安及其邻近行星阿基顿之上，没有哪位大法师比 Old-Mage Jatembe（老法师杰泰姆贝）（爱管闲事之人类男性半神言者）更加闻名遐迩。数百年来，他的行动一直守护着戈拉里安子民及其魔法传承。

Merlin（梅林）（狡黠之人类男性法师）或许是有史以来跨越万界最为著名的大法师，其名声在多个世界与位面之间广为流传。他以好管闲事著称，惯于将能改变世界的神器托付给年轻骑士。这位法师中的法师正是无数有志成为大法师者所效法的典范。

Stardust（星尘）（敢于冒险之血统未知男性太空旅行者）这位大法师以其魔法对自身肉体作出重大改造，再借法术远行至时空最深处。星尘在其所到访诸多星球上的声誉褒贬不一——他惯于以扭曲现实之法术惩治罪犯，而其法术持久效应往往与罪行不成比例，使人惊骇。

无论你眼下的故事与声誉为何，唯有时间方能判定你是否真正配得上大法师之名。力量的种子已在你手中，前路在你足下。锻造你的法术，掌握不朽者之魔力，将现实弯折于你的意志——届时，你方能配得上「大法师」这一称号！

Essence Casting.name: 精质施法 Essence Casting
Essence Casting.text:
精质施法者 vs 范氏施法者

Essence casting allows a spellcaster to cast more spells from some of their best ranks in a day than normal, especially in a day with a large number of encounters. While it might be most dramatic at lower levels when spells are scarce for Vancian spellcasters, this pattern remains the same even at higher levels.

However, it comes at a significant cost: Vancian spellcasters can place powerful buffs and environmental control effects before the fight, repeat recovery spells as long as they have slots to spend, and unleash all their best spells back to back in a crisis. For an example at higher levels, an essence casting 18th-level wizard could cast a 7th-, 8th-, and 9th-rank spell every single encounter of the day, and if the encounter is tougher than expected and stretches on to 7 rounds, they could even cast 2 of each of those ranks and a cantrip. However, if the Vancian wizard goes in completely fresh to that tough encounter, they could cast five 9th-rank spells and two 8th-rank spells. And supposing the tough fight is 5 rounds long instead, the essence wizard is potentially using two cantrips and one each of 7th-, 8th-, and 9th-rank while the Vancian wizard can just unload a 9th-rank spell every single round.

As a result, while they don’t have the same potential to unload all at once, essence casters will usually be much more consistent across a longer adventuring day, and hopefully more fun to play in those easier encounters since you can cast some of your more impactful spells without feeling like you’re leaving yourself vulnerable in case a hard fight comes later in the day!

Magic is formed of four essences: life, matter, mind, and spirit. When two of the four essences of magic are woven together, they form the magical traditions of arcane, divine, occult, and primal magic. While some spellcasters try to conceptualize these essences in discrete “slots” to be used once and faded away into the ether, there are others who focus on the way these essences coalesce into usable form in order to follow the natural cycle of magic, rather than the casting approach these essence casters see as “brute force.” Different cultures have their own name for this phenomenon, but all agree on the fundamentals. The structure of the coalesced essence depends on whether it is physical or spiritual: material essence is physical and travels through a spellcaster’s body almost like blood travels through veins and arteries, while spiritual essence likewise travels through a spellcaster’s soul. Similarly, the way the coalesced essence is energized and moves depends on whether the essence is mental or vital: mental essence responds best to conscious thought and the workings of the mind, while vital essence reacts reflexively based on instinct or faith, like how sometimes people can display abnormal strength in a crisis. Arcane essence is material and mental, divine essence is spiritual and vital, occult essence is spiritual and mental, and primal essence is material and vital.

What is Essence Casting?

Essence casting is an all-day spellcasting system that allows your character to gather essence throughout the battle to cast more powerful spells, rather than limiting spells based on daily spell slots. Full spellcasters can complete essence cycles or cause essence leaks to develop one of several possible strategies, potentially choosing between them on the fly. Essence casting can replace slot-based spellcasting in your game, but if not everyone in your group wants to use essence casting, you could make essence casting into a class archetype instead which grants essence casting to those who take it.

Is Essence Casting For You?

If you always felt uncomfortable with the daily preparation of spells or especially with the need to either stockpile resources and use them sparingly or else blow through them and demand a rest while the rest of the characters are still ready to continue, essence casting is the perfect fit for you. It’s also especially strong in campaigns with a large number of encounters each day, whether they are easier encounters (in which case you’ll make a much bigger impact in every encounter compared to holding back your slots) or harder encounters (in which case you can handle more of them before you’re running on fumes).

However, if you love Vancian casting or your campaigns usually have one or two big fights per day where everyone “novas,” leading with their most powerful abilities at once, essence casting might not be for you. Then again, even when essence casting isn’t as powerful as traditional spellcasting, you might find that it’s more fun for you. Especially if there’s always a specter of another encounter or a night ambush causing you to hold back. Essence casting also isn’t for spellcasters who like to put up a lot of long-lasting effects out of combat, as it’s highly focused on the spells you cast during combat.

For an adventuring day of roughly three to six encounters with a significant enough challenge that spellcasters would want to use their main spells instead of relying on focus spells or cantrips, you should find that the two systems each have strengths and weaknesses (with essence casting getting stronger as you rise in the number of encounters): you can often pull off more of your best spells more confidently with essence casting, but you can cast them exactly when you want them during a given fight with Vancian casting, as long as you have slots left to do so.

Example of Play

Basic Tactics

While essence casting isn’t inherently more complicated than managing spell slots, the complexity lies in a different place, so it’s likely to seem that way at first if you’re used to traditional spellcasting systems. To help you get started, here’s three of the most basic tactics available to full spellcasters starting from 3rd level. Essence cycles tend to be the default for most spellcasters while one long chain is the default for bounded spellcasters, and essence leaks are a little more advanced.

Essence Cycle: This is the most basic strategy for a full spellcaster: you simply continue casting essence spells and building up benefits from essence cycles as long as the encounter continues.

One Long Chain: With this strategy, you stretch out a single chain of spells in an attempt to last the whole encounter. This strategy is easiest for bounded spellcasters like magus or summoner who have plenty of other things they can do with their turns to extend their chain, and who can’t essence cycle even if they wanted to, but it’s also relatively easy for classes with strong 2-action focus spells or other options for their actions than essence spells.

Essence Leak: This is a more advanced strategy than the others for a full spellcaster; you intentionally break your essence cycles early in order to use 1- action or reaction spells with high frequency, with the cost being that you’ll usually need to be casting draw cantrips on your turn. This strategy works best when coordinating with your team and might not be beneficial for all groups compared to a more active essence cycle. For the simplest example of a low-level essence leak strategy, suppose your group skirmished with multiple foes while you were using lose the path turn after turn to shave off multiple actions from different enemies each turn.

Vasvali, a 5th-level witch, and Ruka, a 5th-level wizard, are travelling alongside some companions. Both casters use essence magic, meaning they don’t use spell slots, and can cast magic as often as they like without running out. Ruka is a more traditional caster who is content following a regular essence cycle; Vasvali, however, is more experimental in her magic, and can take tactical risks and gambles others might not.

At some point in their journey, they are set upon by a group of goblin bandits. As combat begins, both Vasvali and Ruka begin drawing power for free. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.cYHvzy96aWk5n8yC]{初次抽取}). They both begin with an essence level of 1, meaning they can only cast 1st-rank spells or cantrips. If they were any more unpracticed, they would begin with an essence level of 0, and would need to rely on a cantrip to begin drawing power (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.jNOZkBE8sd1UhH8o]{抽取戏法}).

As combat starts, the two casters begin casting spells; Ruka unleashes a blast of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.y6rAdMK6EFlV6U0t]{喷吐烈焰} and Strides away from the goblins. Vasvali soddens the earth with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.yAiSNmz39qXOIlco]{泥洼术}. As both are casting spells which have two or three actions, their powers grow; their essence level increases to 2 (@UUID[.ILOvQomWxAWRXHzk#gaining-essence-in-encounters]{遭遇中获得精质}).

On the second round of combat, the two have even greater magic available to them. They can cast spells of a rank equal to or lower than their current essence level. Ruka casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{迷雾术} to provide some cover from nearby archers. Vasvali intends to uses her focus spell, @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.YFusnK3S1rkhfy55]{拘禁字符} (Witches+) to dispatch a particularly nasty bandit. Focus Spells don’t increase your essence level; however, Vasvali is not content with staying at an essence level of 2 this round. As such, she starts by using her third action to use the Essence Conduit action. This allows her to channel essence through her focus spell. When she uses holding glyph, her power grows as if she had cast an essence spell (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GMpbfdVHBUaiIwSy]{精质导管}). As before, their essence level grows, now reaching 3–the highest rank they can currently cast (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.0KTqyVRXp6ylg39q]{精质池}).

The third round provides a complication. Vasvali is wounded by a terrible strike from a goblin.

Distressed by Vasvali’s injury, Ruka runs to her aid, and casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{闪电束} to fry some nearby goblins. Ruka cannot form her magic into 4th-rank spells yet, and yet she has pushed beyond 3rd-rank. Ruka brings her power to an apex, and activates a cycle terminus. Focusing on her control of the essence of mind, she uses the Terminus of Insight, allowing the knowledge of the world to enter her unbidden. Her essence level drops to 0, and she can continue casting spells next turn, repeating the cycle (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.OGeHSfEa8N58Sp8z]{周期终焉}).

Instead of casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{火球术}, Vasvali’s wound forces her to recover, and she casts a 1-action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{治疗术} on herself. This restores 12 HP to herself. Healing magic is difficult to manipulate too often as it interacts directly with the life essence all creatures are made of. Vasvali can heal a maximum number of hit points equal to her highest healing spell’s rank times twelve–in this case, 36. She recovers the 12 HP, so she can now only heal 24 healing for the rest of the encounter–she has to be careful how she spends it (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.odAsOR95Cjuwqixk]{生命精质储池}). To make matters worse, by casting a 1-action spell, Vasvali has thrown her rhythm off; she experiences an essence leak as she tries to force her magic to work quicker than it should. This means all of Vasvali’s built up essences have drained, and her essence level is reset to 0. A fair price for surviving another day, she reasons.

Only a few goblins remain now. As Ruka casts daze, she gathers some essence; her essence level is back to 1. Right before the spell was cast, she was given a free @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识} by her @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.iHEG6M3sZEkJRedO]{洞察终焉} with a +2 circumstance bonus. Had the information revealed these goblins had a particular weakness or had a bad save, she would have been allowed to change the spell; satisfied with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{晕眩术}, though, she casts anyway. Vasvali is a little more impatient, however; she estimates she has the perfect spell to end the fight at 2nd-rank, and doesn’t want to wait until she has drawn enough power. Forcing her way through magic again, she casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.thAHF1zxNplLCJPO]{酸液喷溅}, but rather than draw in power carefully, she performs an unstable draw. She gains 2 essence levels rather than 1, but it’s likely this will lead to another essence leak afterwards (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.nWrMVX6rsQanqjlj]{不稳抽取}).

Ruka casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.0uRpypf1Hi7ahvTl]{粉碎宝石} on the goblins, gaining another free Recall Knowledge. Vasvali then uses final sacrifice on her loathesome familiar, Mandukhees. The explosion defeats the last of the goblins–and in good time–as her unstable draw before did cause another essence leak, bringing her back to 0 again while Ruka had risen to 3. If Ruka had reached a cycle a second time, her Terminus of Insight would have grown even more powerful. She’s grateful that it didn’t go on any longer, though.

As combat ends, the party rests. Vasvali begins to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{再聚能} in order to get her focus points back. While she’s doing so, she automatically restores one third of her Life Essence Resevoir; 12, the same amount as she healed earlier. Ruka casts a spell outside of combat, performing an incantation. She casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.VDudQ4x2ozosAbTb]{隐形术}; rather than being instantaneous like it might be in the heat of combat, it takes about 20 seconds to cast here. She scouts the area nearby to ensure there are no goblins before returning. When she does so, she needs to Refocus as well; if she doesn’t, the next time she enters combat, she won’t be able to draw power at all. If she had any focus points, she’d recover these at the same time. Once everyone is ready, the party continues on their adventure–all without expending daily resources–fully capable for any sort of fight the day may bring them!

无拘形态：害虫变形与动物变形（分别替代害虫形态与动物形态）

凶猛形态：动物变形（替代动物形态；仅限坐骑或掠食者层面）

昆虫形态：动物变形（替代动物形态；仅限飞行或掠食者层面）

元素形态：元素变形（替代元素形态）

怪兽形态：霜巨变形（替代怪兽形态）

植物形态：植物变形（替代植物形态）

应激变形：动物变形（替代飞行形态；仅限飞行层面）

翱翔形态：动物变形（替代动物形态；仅限飞行层面）

暗林形态：害虫变形、动物变形、元素变形（分别替代害虫形态、动物形态与元素形态）

巨龙形态：龙之变形（替代龙之形态）

Changing into imposing creatures in battle is a staple of powerful spellcasters, but battle forms requiring bespoke values for their statistics can render these spells with awkward progressions. Aspect Forms are an alternate battle form system in which players become creatures based on specific templates called aspects, allowing forms to adapt with the spellcaster themselves instead of the rank of their spells.

When you cast an aspect spell with the polymorph trait that grants a battle form, you choose an aspect to become that is listed in the spell, gaining all of the effects appropriate for that aspect as defined in the polymorph trait for the aspect spell. The rank of the aspect battle form spell determines the effects and granted benefits of the spell. You can Dismiss an aspect battle form spell.

If your aspect makes you a Large creature, you have 10 feet of reach, if your aspect makes you a Huge creature, you have 15 feet of reach, and if your aspect makes you a Gargantuan creature you have 20 feet of reach. If you choose a size category one size category smaller than the spells maximum, you increase your land Speed by 10 feet, by 20 feet if you choose a size category two size categories smaller, or by 30 feet if you choose a size category three size categories smaller. A battle form aspect of Tiny size always has a reach of 0 feet.

All aspect battle forms gain the following effects when heightened. If an aspect has a heightened effect, it gains those effects in addition to the effects of its previous heightened entries.

高阶 (3 阶) The aspect’s Strikes deal 2 weapon damage dice and increase the temporary Hit Points per rank by 1. You can be up to Large in size.

高阶 (7 阶) The aspect’s Strikes deal 3 weapon damage dice and increase the temporary Hit Points per rank by 2. You can be up to Huge in size.

高阶 (10 阶) The aspect’s Strikes deal 4 weapon damage dice and increase the temporary Hit Points per rank by 4. You can be up to Gargantuan in size.

Aspect Traits: Polymorph Trait

These effects transform the target into a new form. A target can't be under the effect of more than one polymorph effect at a time. If it comes under the effect of a second polymorph effect, the second polymorph effect attempts to counteract the first. If it succeeds, it takes effect, and if it fails, the spell has no effect on that target. Any Strikes specifically granted by a polymorph effect are magical. Unless otherwise stated, polymorph spells don't allow the target to take on the appearance of a specific individual creature, but rather just a generic creature of a general type or ancestry.

If you take on a battle form with a polymorph spell, your battle form has an AC and spell or ability DCs equal to your spell DC, and it uses your spell attack modifier for its attack rolls. The only Strikes you can make while in an aspect battle form are the Strikes granted to you by your form. You can choose to use your unarmed attack modifier for your attack rolls instead of your spell attack modifier. You are trained in the skills listed in the aspect chosen for your battle form, using either your skill modifier or your spell attack modifier for checks with that skill (whichever is higher). You modify your saves based on your chosen aspect and you gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice the rank of the spell. If the aspect you selected would increase its Hit Points, such as an animal aspect, you increase your temporary Hit Points by the same amount. You gain the abilities and senses listed for your aspect based on the rank of the battle form spell unless otherwise noted in the spell. You do not gain languages associated with the aspect but can speak and understand languages you know normally unless the aspect can’t speak. You cannot Cast a Spell while in an aspect battle form unless the aspect you select lists spells in its entry or would gain spells from an ability (such as the Caster aspect ability).

You take a cumulative –1 penalty to all your DCs and checks while in your battle form for every rank below half your level rounded up of the spell that summoned it. For instance, if you were 11th level and you cast a 4th-rank animal form spell, you would take a –2 penalty to your AC, saves, DCs, and all checks while within the battle form spell since it is 2 ranks below 6 (half your level rounded up).

If you take on a battle form with a polymorph spell, the special statistics can be adjusted only by circumstance bonuses, status bonuses, and penalties. Unless otherwise noted, the battle form prevents you from casting spells, speaking, and using most manipulate actions that require hands. (If there's doubt about whether you can use an action, the GM decides.) Your gear is absorbed into you; the constant abilities of your gear still function, but you can't activate any items. If a polymorph effect causes you to increase in size, you must have space to expand into or the effect is disrupted.

Entity Aspects.name: 实体层面 Entity Aspects
Entity Aspects.text:

特征 aberration

感官 黑暗视觉

语言 varies (see Aberrant Lair)

技能 Intimidation, Occultism, 潜行

Aberrant Lair Aberrations seldom live in plain sight. Choose a habitat for the aspect and gain the selected abilities.

  • Beyond The aspect is a thing not of this world. It speaks aklo and has resistance to mental damage.

  • Fringes The aspect lives on the edge of society. It speaks aklo and can Hide without cover as it blends into the background, either with shapeshifting, magic or camouflage.

  • Underground The aspect hails from underground caves, potentially as deep as the Darklands. It speaks sakvroth and gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.YBgCXb3TEkPv1aEE]{攀爬者} aspect ability.

豁免调整Choose a save for each modifier: –2,+0,+1 or –3,+1,+1 or –3,+0,+2

Eldritch Aspect

This aberration is a servant of dark powers, like a will-o’-wisp or shoggoth.

Cognitohazard (aura 15 feet, mental, incapacitation, visual) Looking directly at this aspect is maddening. The first time a creature enters the aura, it must make a 意志 save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1级} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2级} on a critical failure) for [[/r 1d4]] rounds. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Heightened (4th) Choose either the Feed on Fear ability or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.rU0OMGjiOo6xc7BR]{飞行者} aspect ability.

Feed On Fear While a frightened creature is within its Cognitohazard aura, the aspect gains fast healing equal to the rank of the spell.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.u098thIGDlrHC8G8]{施法者} ability. Cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{晕眩术}, 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{幻痛术}, 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.CQb8HtQ1BPeZmu9h]{愚者之思}, 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{吸血鬼之宴}, 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY]{困惑术}, 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.xFp4EwVcYwSG336t]{滑溜}, 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{失智术}, 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{扭曲心智}, 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.uEyfLoFQsRKBRIcB]{困惑炫彩}

Hypnagog Aspect

This aberration is one heavily associated with dreams and nightmares, like a dramofir or nightgaunt.

近战 1 次要, 伤害 1d4 + 环级 心灵

Prey On The Weary The aspect has a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against creatures that have failed a 意志 save this round. It has a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against fatigued and unconscious creatures.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains your choice of the Flier aspect ability or the ability to once per day cast sleep as an innate spell two ranks below the rank of the spell.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Dream Eater reaction.

Dream Eater r (death, mental) 频率 once per minute; 效果 The aspect eats the dreams of an unconscious creature within 30 feet, causing the target to take 1d8 mental damage per rank of the spell with a basic 意志 save and damage from this effect does not end the unconscious condition. The aspect gains temporary Hit Points equal to the rank of the spell.

Lusus Naturae Aspect

This aberration is a lusus naturae, a creature of freakish nature that ignores the usual rules of biology, like a grindylow or gogiteth.

近战 1 次要 （娴熟或及远）, 伤害 1d4 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Sickening Fear 1 The aspect targets a frightened creature within 30 feet. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1级}. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect begins adapting features of normal animals, perverting them terribly. It gains the 4th-rank feature of an animal aspect.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Disgusting Anatomy aura ability.

Disgusting Anatomy (aura 15 feet, emotion, mental, incapacitation, visual) The aspect’s body acts in ways that sicken onlookers. The first time a creature enters the aura, it must make a Fortitude save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1级} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2级} on a critical failure). Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Stranger Aspect

This aberration is strange, like a blood painter or kuchisake-onna.

感官 varies (see Uncanny Stalker)

Melee 1 次要 (agile or tearing), 伤害 1d6 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Uncanny Stalker The aspect gains either bloodscent as a precise sense with a range of 60 feet or scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

高阶 (4 阶) Choose either Camouflage or Extra Limbs.

Extra Limbs The aspect gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{反应打击} as a reaction.

Camouflage The aspect can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{隐形术} as an innate spell at will.

Heightened (8th) The aspect is a devastating stalker, its choice of Extra Limbs or Camouflage gains the following benefit in addition to the ones listed for 4th rank.

Extra Limbs The aspect can use Reactive Strike once per turn as a free action.

Camouflage The aspect can cast invisibility as a 1-action activity.

Experimental Changes.name: 实验性变更 Experimental Changes
Experimental Changes.text:
可塑准备

用具体法术准备法术位虽具挑战性且强大，但容易导致选择犹豫与法术准备的同质化。预测法术使用时机颇为困难，对于「临时工具」「幻象物体」这类极少影响战斗的小众法术尤甚。这不仅使预测不准的玩家因准备「无用槽位」而感觉受惩罚，亦使玩家干脆避开小众法术，转而准备「战斗中永远有用」的法术。这会导致施法者准备同质化——他们倾向于准备少数稳定强大的法术，而完全放弃小众法术。「可塑准备」是一项替代规则，旨在为准备式施法者提供更大宽容度，让他们能在不超出充分准备所及威能上限的前提下，预判冒险日所需并准备一些小众选项red wizard.

Using this alternate rule, prepared spellcasters choose a number of different spells at each rank equal to the number of spells they could prepare for that rank during their daily preparations. A prepared spellcaster can then cast any of the spells it chose to prepare with the spell slots it has available at that rank. A prepared spellcaster must still have prepared the spell at the rank equal to the spell slot in order to cast it. Spell slots gained for a specific spell or set of spells, such as curriculum spells, must still be used to cast those spells.

For example, a 5th-level wizard can prepare three 1st-rank spells, three 2nd-rank spells, and two 3rd-rank spells during their daily preparations. Using the Malleable Preparation, they choose to prepare breathe fire, fear, and jump at 1st-rank, dispel magic, enlarge, and web at 2nd-rank, and slow and fireball at 3rd-rank. They can then spend any slots of that rank to cast any of the spells they have prepared much like a spontaneous spellcaster would cast their spells from their repertoire. The wizard could not, however, cast fear as a 3rd-rank spell, because they only prepared it as a 1st-rank spell (but could have if they chose to prepare fear instead of fireball in their 3rd-rank prepared slots).

Compensation for Spontaneous

As a result of flexible preparation, some might feel that spontaneous casters aren’t able to compete against the flexibility available to the prepared casters. Signature spells allowing for spontaneous heightening is a powerful ability, but the inability for spontaneous casters to adapt over their career can also be a burden to the player in the same way daily planning might blight a prepared caster. For compensation to spontaneous casters playing with Malleable Preparation, spontaneous casters can retrain spells in their spell repertoire with 1 day of downtime instead of 1 week.

Incapacitation

Incapacitated by Essence

These rules are highly experimental when it comes to integrating with the essence system, as incapacitation spells can be used easily to subvert low and moderate encounters from the jump without much risk, as Unstable Draw isn’t even necessary for hitting a group of enemies with an area of effect spell that could incapacitate them (such as calm). For this reason, GMs should weigh the pros and cons of including these rules even more so than usual when spellcasters in the system are using essence casting and incapacitation spells.

Incapacitation can serve an essential function in keeping balance, especially when facing challenging encounters that might otherwise be trivialized with a spell. Boss fights are often the example cited when discussing the need for the trait. At the same time, many players feel Incapacitation can unduly punish casters, especially at higher levels when they find that many of their lower-rank spell slots no longer work, even on trivial encounters.

Consolation Prize Retained

One way to resolve the constraints of Incapacitation is to state the degree of success change only applies to the Critical Failure and Failure effects for a save or the Critical Success and Success effect for an effect that would require an attack roll or check.

While this does pose risk on some spells against higher level enemies, their save and DC advantages will prevent them from falling into categories that would render them completely immune spells (due to rolling a success with normal incapacitation rules).

For example, a 7th-level sorcerer casting a 4th-rank calm on an level 10 enemy that rolls a success on their save would keep the results of the success instead of getting a critical success from incapacitation. If a second level 10 enemy in the area of the calm rolls a critical failure on their save, they would still get the failure effect as normal, since this still applies to critical failures.

Essence Casting with NPCs

If implemented without modification, making NPCs use essence casting is a direct nerf. Unlike a PC, an NPC will usually only be alive for a single fight or two, rather than several over the course of a day. Limiting the spells they cast to work in the same ways as PCs strictly makes enemy spellcasters weaker. However, in a game that exclusively uses essence magic, this may feel unfair to players who see enemy casters breaking the established rules of magic.

The solution to this problem is to give enemy casters bespoke termini. These termini are more powerful, similar in nature to Dungeons & Dragons’ 5th Edition’s concept of Lair Actions. We advise you to create unique ones for your enemy casters, especially bosses, to accentuate them in your campaign. Terminus actions for NPCs should generally be designed around the NPC in question and themetically appropriate for their spell list. A caster that specializes in summoning would be a good fit for a summon-based terminus action, such as Terminus of Calling.

The following are four NPC Terminus actions you can use for essence caster NPCs: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.c5ICTG8AOo2fUC4c]{召唤终焉}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.efyJD0jrp6Q5P3LC]{灾劫终焉}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.VizdsRzr1OuDPuO3]{驱散终焉}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.LJL6bpAJXNddjQCX]{恐惧终焉}

所有魔类层面在其各自层面所列统计之外，皆共有以下统计。

感官 黑暗视觉

豁免调整Choose a save for each modifier: –3,+1,+1

抗力 varies (see Fiendish Boon); 弱点 holy

Fiendish Boon Choose either masochistic boon or sadistic boon.

Masochistic Boon Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage. The aspect gains resistance against the chosen damage type.

Sadistic Boon Choose bleed, fire, mental, or void damage. When the aspect critically succeeds at a Strike, it deals persistent damage of the chosen type equal to its Strike’s weapon damage dice.

近战 1 主要, 伤害 1d6 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Unholy The aspect deals 1 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die to creatures with the holy trait and its Strikes have the unholy trait.

Daemon Aspect

This hateful fiend is from Abaddon, such as a venedaemon or an astradaemon.

Traits daemon

语言 Daemonic

技能 潜行

Melee 1 次要 （娴熟）, 伤害 1d4 + rank 钝击、穿刺或挥砍

Hunter of Death The aspect Strikes deal 1 additional spirit damage per weapon damage dice against creatures with fewer than half its maximum Hit Points.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Fiendish Boon.
Masochistic Boon The aspect is immune to fear and death effects.
Sadistic Boon When a creature within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the aspect regains a number of Hit Points equal to twice the rank of the spell.

高阶 (8 阶) The daemon gains the Eat Soul reaction.

Eat Soul R (death) 频率 once per minute; 触发 The aspect reduces a living creature to 0 Hit Points; 效果 The aspect eats the creature’s soul, causing it to die immediately. It gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws for the duration of the spell.

Demon Aspect

This sin-infused fiend comes from the pits of the Outer Rifts, like a pusk or an omox.

特征 demon

语言 Cthonian

技能 Athletics

Melee 1 次要 （娴熟）, 伤害 1d4 + 环级 酸性 or piercing

Sin Strike 1 The aspect makes a Strike against an enemy. If the Strike is successful, the target is marked with sin and takes mental damage equal to the rank of the spell at the end of each turn the mark is present. A creature can spend an Interact action to remove the mark. Creatures with the holy trait are immune to this effect. After a creature has removed the mark, it is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Fiendish Boon.
Masochistic Boon Each time a creature marked by Sin Strike deals slashing or piercing damage to the aspect, the attacker is sprayed with vile blood, which deals acid damage equal to twice the rank of the spell.
Sadistic Boon The aspect treats targets marked by its Sin Strike as off-guard.

高阶 (8 阶) The aspect gains the Weight of Sins activity.

Weight of Sins 2 (emotion, mental, unholy) The aspect chooses a non-holy creature within 30 feet and brings the weight of their sins to the forefront of their mind. The creature takes 1d6 mental damage per rank of the spell with a basic 意志 save. If the creature is marked by Sin Strike, it takes double damage. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Devil Aspect

This fiend hails from Hell, like a phistophilus or an erinyes, and delights in tyranny and torment.

Traits devil

技能 Religion, Legal Lore

Legal Counsel The aspect is a really good lawyer. It gains the Enhanced Aid (Legal Lore) aspect ability.

抗力 fire

Melee 1 次要 (agile or range 30 feet), 伤害 1d4 + 环级 火焰 or piercing

高阶 (4 阶) The aspect gains an additional benefit from its Fiendish Boon.
Masochistic Boon The aspect is immune to fire damage and gains the Flier aspect ability.
Sadistic Boon The aspect gains the Hinder reaction.

Hinder R 触发 An enemy is about to use an action that requires a skill check or attack roll; 需求 You have prepared to hinder (see below); 效果 The aspect attempts to hinder an enemy. To use this reaction, it must first prepare to hinder, usually by using an action during your turn. Attempt a Legal Lore check against the triggering enemies 意志 DC. If its check is successful, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to the triggering check or a –2 circumstance penalty if it was a critical success.
